items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: I played with Blue. We had a little band with Blue. Blue was playing with me.

ctx.x: What did he play? He played Coney. You mean the guy that was any kind of Blue? No, it wasn't a kind of Blue. No, it wasn't no kind of Blue.
I played with Blue. We had a little band with Blue. Blue was playing with me. He died, boy boy. He drank so much wine, boy boy. He passed away.
Where was this place that you were playing on, Allen, Iowa? What's the name of that?
